info.name: ProcuraX — Complete Backend API
info.description: Submission-ready ProcuraX Postman collection covering the canonical BUYER, SUPPLIER, and ADMIN workflows: authentication, supplier verification, RFQs, quotations, evaluation/award, purchase orders, goods receipts, invoices, Stripe payments, refunds, disputes, notifications, audit logs, and analytics. Start with the folders in numeric order. The collection stores tokens and entity IDs in collection variables as requests succeed. Use Stripe webhook delivery/Stripe CLI for signed webhook events rather than manually forging webhook requests.

item.name: 10 - Stripe Payments
item.description: Canonical payment flow for the approved APX-INV-0001 invoice. Stripe webhook delivery is intentionally not simulated here; use Stripe CLI or a deployed webhook endpoint when doing final integration testing.

request.description: Creates the Stripe Checkout session for the approved canonical invoice. Repeated calls reuse the same active payment/session instead of creating duplicate attempts.

item.name: 11 - Refunds & Reconciliation
item.description: Canonical refund workflow for the same Stripe payment. This folder becomes executable after the canonical payment has succeeded through Stripe and the webhook has marked it SUCCEEDED.

request.description: Requests the remaining refundable balance. Omitting amount means full remaining refund.
